passes.name: pilot
passes.purpose: Both sides spawn the backend and call it over IPC: per-iteration time for the ETA, and the result hashes at it.n 0 and 1 must match across sides (hashes.mjs). No counts pass: the renderer runs no React work here, and the hash is the scenario's own count.

passes.name: main
passes.purpose: The timing verdict at size S (30 txs × 100 inputs/outputs, 160 addresses): 4 v 4 sessions at 4x and 1x. The utility process is not throttled, so the two rates differ only in the renderer's IPC share.

passes.name: ctl
passes.purpose: Paired control: 0 / 10 ms injected per 10 txs (30 ms per call) on the renderer must land in the round trip (k 8, warm-up 2: 3 pairs a session).

passes.name: big
passes.purpose: Second size, M (60 txs × 200 inputs/outputs, 300 addresses): flat, linear or superlinear growth of the round trip. ABBAABBA up front: 2 v 2 can never be called.

passes.name: warm
passes.purpose: The call on a warm backend, as the app makes most of them (it keeps the backend alive): before() spawns it and calls it once on other data, so the timed call is the second into the process. spawn.ms reads ~0 here (not timed). Runs with --only=warm.

passes.name: more
passes.purpose: One more ABBA block of main (sessions main-5-A …). Runs only with --only=more, when aggregate's advice says more sessions could change a verdict.
